He et al. 2016 measured empty recombinant 
particles at 24.6 ± 2.0 nm by negative-stain TEM. McIver et al. 2026 resolved the empty shell by cryo-EM as an icosahedral homo-60-mer at 2.0 Å (PDB 9RY4 / EMD-54372); T=1 is assigned from the experimentally established 60-subunit icosahedral architecture. PDB 9RY7 / EMD-54373 is a focused closed five-fold pentamer derived from the same empty cage and is treated as a local pore structure rather than a separate assembly.
source_id: He et al. 2016; McIver et al. 2026
